lines.zh: 我的腿骨碰在一起，咔嗒作响。
lines.en: My leg bones knock together with a clatter.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，比从前差远了。
lines.en: I walk slowly, far worse than I used to.

lines.zh: 关节缺了一块，走路总是偏左。
lines.en: A joint is missing, so I always drift left.

lines.zh: 一步一晃，我这副架子不太稳。
lines.en: I sway with every step; this frame is unsteady.

lines.zh: 我一路走，一路掉骨屑。
lines.en: I leave bone dust behind me all the way.

lines.zh: 没有弓，我只能靠这两条腿。
lines.en: Without a bow, I have only these two legs.

lines.zh: 肋骨卡着风，走起来呼呼响。
lines.en: Wind catches in my ribs and whistles as I walk.

lines.zh: 我朝有声音的地方挪过去。
lines.en: I shuffle toward whatever makes a sound.

lines.zh: 腿骨有点松，我得走慢点。
lines.en: My leg bones are loose, so I must go slowly.

lines.zh: 我踩过石子，脚趾少了两根。
lines.en: I step on gravel and two toes are missing.

lines.zh: 这副架子走不了远路。
lines.en: This frame cannot carry me far.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条不听使唤的腿。
lines.en: I drag one leg that will not obey me.

lines.zh: 我站着，关节自己响个不停。
lines.en: I stand still and my joints rattle on their own.

lines.zh: 风穿过我的胸腔，很凉。
lines.en: Wind passes through my chest cavity and it is cold.

lines.zh: 我忘了自己在这里站了多久。
lines.en: I have forgotten how long I have stood here.

lines.zh: 我抬手挠头，却挠到空的。
lines.en: I reach to scratch my head and find nothing.

lines.zh: 有只虫在肋骨间做了窝。
lines.en: A bug has made a nest between my ribs.

lines.zh: 我低头看自己的手，只剩骨头。
lines.en: I look at my hand and only bone is left.

lines.zh: 什么都不做的时候，我最像死的。
lines.en: Doing nothing, I look most like the dead.

lines.zh: 我的下颌松了，合不太上。
lines.en: My jaw has come loose and will not close.

lines.zh: 我在等天黑，还是在等别的。
lines.en: I am waiting for night, or for something else.

lines.zh: 骨头在响，我一动也不敢动。
lines.en: My bones creak and I dare not move.

lines.zh: 我抬起空空的眼窝看你。
lines.en: I lift my empty eye sockets toward you.

lines.zh: 你身上有肉，我没有。
lines.en: You have flesh; I do not.

lines.zh: 我歪着颅骨，打量你的高度。
lines.en: I tilt my skull and measure your height.

lines.zh: 你呼吸的声音，我听得清楚。
lines.en: I hear the sound of your breathing clearly.

lines.zh: 我记得活人是什么样子。
lines.en: I still remember what the living look like.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的膝盖，那里好打断。
lines.en: I stare at your knees; they would break easily.

lines.zh: 你没有弓，我也没有。
lines.en: You have no bow, and neither do I.

lines.zh: 我们隔着三步，谁都不动。
lines.en: Three steps apart, neither of us moves.

lines.zh: 我的头骨在光下泛白。
lines.en: My skull gleams white in the light.

lines.zh: 你看起来比我结实多了。
lines.en: You look far sturdier than I am.

lines.zh: 我的肋骨断了一根，不碍事。
lines.en: One rib broke, and it hardly matters.

lines.zh: 你打掉我半边下颌。
lines.en: You knocked off half my jaw.

lines.zh: 骨头裂开的声音，我听得清楚。
lines.en: I hear my own bone splitting clearly.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，腿骨差点脱开。
lines.en: I step back and my leg bone nearly slips out.

lines.zh: 疼是没了，可我知道坏了。
lines.en: The pain is gone, but I know it is bad.

lines.zh: 你把我打矮了半个头。
lines.en: That blow made me a little shorter.

lines.zh: 我的指骨全断了，握不住东西。
lines.en: All my finger bones broke; I cannot grip.

lines.zh: 你砍到我的脊椎，我抖了一下。
lines.en: You struck my spine and I shuddered.

lines.zh: 碎屑掉在地上，我捡不回来。
lines.en: The splinters fell and I cannot gather them.

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃，但还站着。
lines.en: I wobble, but I am still standing.

lines.zh: 你不用拿东西引我，我不吃。
lines.en: No need to lure me with food; I do not eat.

lines.zh: 我喉咙里只有风，咽不下东西。
lines.en: Only wind in my throat; nothing goes down.

lines.zh: 你把食物收好，我只想打你。
lines.en: Put the food away; I only want to fight.

lines.zh: 闻得到香味，可我咬不动。
lines.en: I smell it, but I cannot chew.

lines.zh: 东西掉在地上，我也不捡。
lines.en: Even if it drops on the ground, I will not take it.

lines.zh: 我什么都咽不下去，喉咙是空的。
lines.en: I can swallow nothing; my throat is empty.

lines.zh: 别晃那块肉，我一点都不馋。
lines.en: Stop waving that meat; I am not tempted.

lines.zh: 骨头对骨头，才算公平。
lines.en: Bone against bone would be fairer.

lines.zh: 你的好意，我受不住。
lines.en: I cannot accept your kindness.

lines.zh: 我饿，但饿已伤不到我。
lines.en: I am hungry, but hunger can no longer hurt me.

lines.zh: 你一撞，我的肋骨掉了一根。
lines.en: One bump from you and a rib falls out.

lines.zh: 别靠这么近，我身上全是尖的。
lines.en: Do not come so close; I am all sharp edges.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音像敲木柴。
lines.en: We collide with a sound like knocking firewood.

lines.zh: 我的肩骨卡进你的甲缝里。
lines.en: My shoulder bone wedges into your armor gap.

lines.zh: 让开，我不想在这儿散架。
lines.en: Move aside; I do not want to fall apart here.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的指骨，它碎了。
lines.en: You stepped on my finger bone and it cracked.

lines.zh: 这一下把我的胯骨撞歪了。
lines.en: That knocked my hip bone out of line.

lines.zh: 我退开，怕再碰就散。
lines.en: I back away, afraid another touch will scatter me.

lines.zh: 我用肘骨顶回去，很轻。
lines.en: I push back with my elbow, and it is weak.

lines.zh: 撞得不重，我的骨头却响了。
lines.en: It was not hard, yet my bones rattled.

lines.zh: 我连自己的影子都追不上。
lines.en: I cannot even catch my own shadow.

lines.zh: 这副样子，没什么好说的。
lines.en: In this state, there is little to say.

lines.zh: 我的同伴都散在别处了。
lines.en: My companions scattered elsewhere long ago.

lines.zh: 亲近会让骨头断得更快。
lines.en: Closeness would break my bones sooner.

lines.zh: 我记不清活着时的事了。
lines.en: I cannot recall my living days.

lines.zh: 空地上一具骷髅，站着而已。
lines.en: A skeleton in an empty field, merely standing.

lines.zh: 我只需要风，不需要别的。
lines.en: I need only the wind, nothing more.

lines.zh: 别碰我，我怕自己散开。
lines.en: Do not touch me; I fear I will come apart.

lines.zh: 这种事，我早就放下了。
lines.en: That sort of thing, I let go long ago.

lines.zh: 我唯一的伴是这些响的骨头。
lines.en: My only company is these rattling bones.

lines.zh: 我捡起一根断骨，比划长度。
lines.en: I pick up a broken bone and measure its length.

lines.zh: 这截骨头也许能补上我的肋骨。
lines.en: This bone might replace one of my ribs.

lines.zh: 我弯腰去捡，脊柱响了一下。
lines.en: I bend to pick it up and my spine pops.

lines.zh: 铁片我拿不住，指头是滑的。
lines.en: I cannot hold iron; my fingers are bare.

lines.zh: 我把掉的东西捡起来看看。
lines.en: I pick up what dropped and look at it.

lines.zh: 这块石头，正好压住松的关节。
lines.en: This stone will hold my loose joint.

lines.zh: 我捡到一枚牙，不是我的。
lines.en: I find a tooth, and it is not mine.

lines.zh: 空手捡东西，总掉第二次。
lines.en: Picking things up bare-handed, I always drop them twice.

lines.zh: 我把捡的骨头都塞进胸腔。
lines.en: I stuff the bones I find into my chest.

lines.zh: 有用的留着，没用的踢开。
lines.en: I keep what is useful and kick the rest away.

lines.zh: 有脚步，我转头找那个方向。
lines.en: Footsteps; I turn my skull toward the sound.

lines.zh: 你没有弓，那我们就近身。
lines.en: You have no bow, so we fight up close.

lines.zh: 我盯上了这个活人。
lines.en: I have picked out this living one.

lines.zh: 我虽弱，也能打上一架。
lines.en: I am feeble, but I can still fight once.

lines.zh: 目标就在前面，我挪过去。
lines.en: The target is ahead; I shuffle toward it.

lines.zh: 这个人在挖矿，背对着我。
lines.en: This one is mining with his back to me.

lines.zh: 我听见盔甲的响，很近了。
lines.en: I hear armor clinking, very close now.

lines.zh: 活的东西，我都要试一试。
lines.en: Anything living, I will test my luck against.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝对上了你的影子。
lines.en: My sockets line up with your shadow.

lines.zh: 就他了，别的人我够不着。
lines.en: Him, then; I cannot reach the others.

lines.zh: 我抬起手，指了一下你。
lines.en: I raise a hand and point at you.

lines.zh: 距离三步，我决定动手。
lines.en: Three steps away, I decide to strike.

lines.zh: 门口的响动，把我引了过来。
lines.en: The noise at the door drew me over.

lines.zh: 我锁定了，哪怕打不过。
lines.en: I have locked on, even if I lose.

lines.zh: 你咳嗽了一声，我就找到你了。
lines.en: You coughed once. That was enough to find you.

lines.zh: 我一直跟着，走得很慢。
lines.en: I keep following, walking very slowly.

lines.zh: 你走远了，我就沿着墙找。
lines.en: When you get far, I search along the walls.

lines.zh: 我听见你踩断的树枝。
lines.en: I hear the branch you snapped underfoot.

lines.zh: 我不喊叫，喊也没用。
lines.en: I do not shout; shouting would do no good.

lines.zh: 你绕到树后，我还在看那边。
lines.en: You slip behind the tree and I still watch there.

lines.zh: 我的步子短，你迟早要停。
lines.en: My steps are short; you must stop eventually.

lines.zh: 我记住了你的高度和气味。
lines.en: I have memorized your height and your scent.

lines.zh: 你躲进洞里，我在洞口等。
lines.en: You hide in a cave; I wait at the mouth.

lines.zh: 追不上的时候，我就慢慢挪。
lines.en: When I cannot catch you, I just keep shuffling.

lines.zh: 我沿着你的脚印，一步不漏。
lines.en: I follow your footprints without missing one.

lines.zh: 你别以为我这副架子跑不动。
lines.en: Do not assume this frame cannot run.

lines.zh: 我一直看着，直到你露出后背。
lines.en: I keep watching until you show your back.

lines.zh: 你上坡时慢，那正是机会。
lines.en: You slow on the slope, and that is my chance.

lines.zh: 我不用追太紧，你还会回来。
lines.en: I need not chase closely; you will come back.

lines.zh: 我扶着墙追，慢一点也无妨。
lines.en: I chase along the wall. Slow is fine.

lines.zh: 你跑过石桥，我停在桥头。
lines.en: You cross the stone bridge; I stop at its head.

lines.zh: 我的膝盖响，但脚没停。
lines.en: My knees creak, but my feet keep going.

lines.zh: 你在坡下歇气，我正好下来。
lines.en: You rest below the slope. I come down right then.

lines.zh: 我抡起手臂砸下去。
lines.en: I swing my arm down at you.

lines.zh: 这一拳没什么力气，但我尽力了。
lines.en: This punch has little force, but I tried.

lines.zh: 我的指骨刮过你的手臂。
lines.en: My finger bones scrape across your arm.

lines.zh: 我没有武器，只能用骨头。
lines.en: I have no weapon, only my bones.

lines.zh: 打在你甲上，我的手先断。
lines.en: I hit your armor and my hand breaks first.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，整个人撞你。
lines.en: I lunge and hit you with my whole body.

lines.zh: 一记肘击，我自己也歪了。
lines.en: One elbow strike, and I am knocked crooked too.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的衣领往下拽。
lines.en: I grab your collar and pull you down.

lines.zh: 骨头当棍子使，还凑合。
lines.en: Bones work as clubs, more or less.

lines.zh: 我打得不重，可我不会停。
lines.en: My blows are light, but I will not stop.

lines.zh: 膝盖顶上去，声音很闷。
lines.en: I drive a knee in, and the sound is dull.

lines.zh: 你退，我就用骨头敲你的膝。
lines.en: You step back once and I follow once.

lines.zh: 我把整条胳膊甩过去。
lines.en: I throw my whole arm at you.

lines.zh: 这一下用完，我的肩脱了。
lines.en: After that swing, my shoulder came loose.

lines.zh: 我用头骨撞你的小腹。
lines.en: I drive my skull into your gut.

lines.zh: 我的拳头落在盾上，散了架。
lines.en: My fist hits the shield and falls apart.

lines.zh: 我从阴影里站起来，骨头响成一片。
lines.en: I rise from the shadows with my bones clattering.

lines.zh: 这副旧架子又被拼起来了。
lines.en: This old frame has been put together again.

lines.zh: 我在暗处睁眼，什么都看得见。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the dark and see everything.

lines.zh: 泥土下面，我慢慢松开手指。
lines.en: Under the dirt, I slowly unclench my fingers.

lines.zh: 我出现时，肩上还挂着草。
lines.en: When I appear, grass still clings to my shoulders.

lines.zh: 又是一具站起来的骷髅。
lines.en: Another skeleton, standing up again.

lines.zh: 我从墓边爬出，抖掉碎石。
lines.en: I crawl from the graveside and shake off gravel.

lines.zh: 黑夜给了我一副旧骨头。
lines.en: The night gave me an old set of bones.

lines.zh: 我醒得比同伴都晚。
lines.en: I woke later than the rest of my kind.

lines.zh: 这次拼得不太对，腿是反的。
lines.en: This assembly went wrong; my legs are backwards.

lines.zh: 我一站起，风就从肋骨穿过。
lines.en: As I stand, wind passes through my ribs.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有活人的动静。
lines.en: I hear living things moving in the distance.

lines.zh: 地底的骨头，总会自己找回来。
lines.en: Bones underground always find their way back.

lines.zh: 我来了，虽然不太结实。
lines.en: I have arrived, though not very sturdy.

lines.zh: 火烤得我的骨头开裂。
lines.en: The fire cracks my bones apart.

lines.zh: 摔下去，我整副架子散了。
lines.en: I land and my whole frame comes apart.

lines.zh: 我在水里散开，慢慢沉底。
lines.en: I come apart in the water and sink.

lines.zh: 炸开后，我的骨头飞得很远。
lines.en: After the blast, my bones flew far.

lines.zh: 一根箭穿过我的肋骨缝。
lines.en: An arrow passes between my ribs.

lines.zh: 那股力量震得我骨头作响。
lines.en: That force makes my bones ring.

lines.zh: 我本就没得吃，饿不饿一样。
lines.en: I have nothing to eat anyway; hunger changes nothing.

lines.zh: 雷劈过，我的骨头更白了。
lines.en: Lightning burned me pale.

lines.zh: 黑里没有风，我的骨头静了。
lines.en: In the dark there is no wind, and my bones are still.
